messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — running an observability office-hours session at 3pm PT. Main ask: do a short deep-dive on latency signals (p50/p95/p99), TTFT, and tokens/sec breakdowns. Bring any dashboards/queries you want reviewed.

alex: I'll join. Could someone paste the Grafana panels we usually point folks to? I want to show the delta between cached vs. cold TTFT.

jin: @alex @maya — use dashboard https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/serving-latency (panel ids: 2=p50,3=p95,4=p99,7=ttft). Also Jaeger traces: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=runtime&tags=ttft.

maya: thx. Quick PromQL snippets I'll throw in the slides: 
```
# p95 TTFT for successful responses
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
# tokens/sec by model
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)
```

alex: Perfect. Can we also show a tokens/sec per-shard view? Ops asked for that yesterday.

jin: Yep — this one: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model, shard)
```
small note: shard label is only present on Dedicated hosts.

maya: For the office hours, can someone bring an example alert tuning request? We had noise from the p99 alert last week. Want to show how to relax window and avoid noisy pages.

alex: I'll bring the alert rule diff. TL;DR suggestion: move p99 trigger from 5m->10m and require >2 hosts affected. Also use increase of 30% over baseline instead of absolute threshold.

jin: That matches my proposal. I'll add a runbook snippet for investigating high TTFT: check KV cache hit ratio, GPU saturation (nvml metrics), then trace a slow request id via jaeger link.

ops-bot: Deploybot: Updated alert "serving_ttft_p99" config applied to staging at 2024-07-01T18:12:05Z. :white_check_mark:

maya: Awesome. Last request — anyone with a recent p99 incident, DM me a few traces (root span id) beforehand so we can anonymize before demo. See you at 3pm! :raised_hands:
